ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low global contrast ratio; approximately 95% of visible ventral fluke pixels reside in the low-intensity (dark) range, with high-intensity (white) pixels restricted to distal tips and sparse micro-spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity dark field across the entire fluke body. High-intensity geometric clusters are localized at the distal lobe tips (coordinates: extreme left and right boundaries) with isolated, near-pixel-level white spots scattered across the central surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 135 degrees and a moderate depth relative to the lobe vertical axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, irregular serration profile along the trailing edge with pixel-amplitude variations (peaks/valleys) ranging from low-frequency on outer sections to higher-frequency near the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Mathematical convex curvature observed from the median notch extending to the distal tips on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, dense white pixel clusters representing localized roughly circular regions at the distal lobe tips, signifying barnacle colonization points.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (high-intensity relative to background) observed as scratches on the mid-ventral surface of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent high-intensity, textured calcified masses at the extreme distal tips of both fluke lobes.
